Class MessageDetail

Namespace
NuvTools.Common.ResultWrapper
Assembly
NuvTools.Common.dll

Represents a detailed message related to an operation result, such as informational, success, warning, or error messages.

public record MessageDetail : IEquatable<MessageDetail>

Examples

Example usage:

var message = new MessageDetail(
    Title: "Validation failed",
    Detail: "The email address format is invalid.",
    Code: "VAL001",
    Severity: Severity.Warning
);

Remarks

The MessageDetail record is typically used as part of a Result or Result<T> object to provide structured feedback about an operation. It allows developers to capture human-readable messages along with metadata such as message code and severity.

Parameters

Title string

The short, human-readable message summarizing the event or result.

Detail string

An optional detailed description that provides more context or technical information about the message.

Code string

An optional identifier that uniquely represents the message type or category, useful for localization, logging, or client-side handling.

Severity Severity?

The severity level of the message (e.g., Information, Warning, Error).
